card.name: Praise adjectives and 'Imp-air-ment'
card.fires_on: Adjectives of praise or prominence in biographical or historical prose, such as excellent, distinguished, prominent and outstanding. Also the 'air' piece inside 'Impairment' in dose-adjustment table titles.

card.writes: Promotes words like 'especially' and 'deeply' and suppresses some word endings, so it mostly adds an intensifying or praising continuation.
card.plain: It fires on words that call a person notable, and on the middle of the word 'impairment' in dosing tables.
